description:
Ontology of Continua — Core v1.3.0

This release prepares the source-first OC Core 1.3 dual-track science package for public publication through the existing open foundation repository.

The primary scientific artifact is the LaTeX-derived master monograph rebuilt from the public source corpus. The release includes canonical English, Russian, and German master monographs, each rebuilt as a native proof-bearing route from the public source corpus.

The master monograph now carries explicit front matter, reader guidance, a theorem roadmap, worked examples, reviewer-navigation appendices, figures, and the Core 1.3 foundational consistency dossier inside the outward scholarly artifact itself.

A separate journal-core extraction provides the shorter editorial route, with English as the master language and Russian and German companion translations already included in the release-supported journal package.

The scientific body stays aligned with the audited Core 1.2 public source corpus while explicitly adding the Core 1.3 source-audit, theorem-fate, chronology, and publication-boundary layers.
notes: Prepared from the OC Core 1.3 source-first dual-track package. The English, Russian, and German monograph lanes are all native proof-bearing masters within the same release family. The journal core ships with release-ready English, Russian, and German lanes in the same publication family. The monograph includes the theorem roadmap, worked examples, reviewer-navigation appendix, and the Core 1.3 foundational consistency dossier.
title: Ontology of Continua — Core v1.3.0
